input.content:
<document id=DOC_posting_odd_headers>
What you will need on day one.
1. Python.
2. SQL.

What would make you stand out.
3. Grafana.
4. Technical writing.
</document>

The posting above groups its requirements under headers. Say for each
header whether the requirements under it are mandatory or optional, and
say what in the header told you.

response.text:
- **“What you will need on day one.” — Mandatory.** “Will need” signals requirements expected from the start: Python and SQL.
- **“What would make you stand out.” — Optional.** “Would make you stand out” signals advantages rather than prerequisites: Grafana and technical writing.
